profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Researcher with experience developing data analytics tools for organizations from neuroscience and psychology labs to nonprofits and schools. Experiential and former classroom educator for students between six and sixty, campers to PhD candidates. Leadership trainer committed to developing strong teams with an ethic of care and collaboration.

positions.title: Coding & Statistics Self-Study
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Pandas (Software) · Econometrics · Web Design · Python

positions.title: Princeton University Tiger Futures Fellow
positions.description:
•	Planned and ran over 120 events to foster European Jewish community, including teaching weekly bilingual Jewish education courses to undergraduate and graduate students in Berlin, Barcelona, & Amsterdam
•	Organized database for Ukraine relief effort, housed refugees and created integration programs
•	Developed spreadsheet tools for tracking funder outreach and participant demographics
positions.insights: Skills: Google Sheets · Teaching · Community Organizing · Refugee Resettlement · Google Apps Script

positions.title: Database Manager & Leadership Trainer
positions.description:
• Developed SQL-powered logistics database to organize 70 trips for >400 campers, personally led four outdoor leadership backpacking trips in the Colorado Rockies 
• Taught leadership-development course to global network of staff based on independent research project
positions.insights: Skills: Google Sheets · JavaScript · SQL · Google Apps Script · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Literature Researcher
positions.description: Read and analyzed 188 books for independent project on political psychology and leadership, developed leadership course (above) for experiential educators

positions.title: Teacher Resident
positions.description:
•	Lead teacher for two high-school Social Studies courses, assistant teacher for two writing classes while attending a full graduate level pedagogy course-load in the evening
•	Programmed Google Apps Script tools for tracking student participation and work done in zoom classes
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · Curriculum Development · Google Apps Script · Holistic Education

positions.title: Co-Chair of Leader Trainer Committee
positions.description: Co-Chair committee developing and refining the largest single outdoor orientation program in the U.S and honing the accompanying leadership program, the most extensive at Princeton, training almost 90 new leaders per year in flexible, sensitive, interpersonal leadership coupled with strong technical and first-aid skills

positions.title: Leader Trainer
positions.description: Lead intensive biannual leader trainer trips, 11 hours a day of observing and conducting medical and interpersonal simulations, 7 hours of group debriefing and individual coaching on personalized growth goals

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description: Led yearly backpacking/canoeing orientation trips for up to ten first-years to create intentional community and self-confidence

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description: Lead teacher (3 lessons per day) in English and Circus Arts for 41 students

positions.title: Owner and Creator
positions.description: Co-Founder and CEO of handmade bow tie company. Featured in the Boston Globe’s Business section.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Researched and analyzed reports and legislation from refugee integration sites across Europe and wrote the first official report of the European Centre for Refugee Integration in Higher Education (EUCRITE), an EU organization
•	Conducted quantitative/qualitative analysis of internal review materials (interviews and surveys) to improve the center’s programs

company.name: Central Coordinating Office for Refugee Integration

positions.title: Unit Head
positions.description:
•	Developed and carried out curricula about environmental activism and coached counselors to create and deliver their own lesson plans at environmentally-focused summer camp
•	Promoted twice over the summer to supervise a total of 19 counselors & CITs and be responsible for over 70 campers
•	Worked with counselors daily to develop individualized plans for campers that took into account group dynamics & mental health

company.name: The Jewish Alliance for Law and Social Action

educations.fieldOfStudy: Comparative Literature, Certificate in German Language and Culture

honors.title: Department of German Book Prize for Excellence in German Studies
honors.issuer: Issued by Princeton University Department of German in collaboration with the Consulate General of Germany · Apr 2019

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Big Brothers Big Sisters of America
volunteerExperiences.description: •	Mentor to local "little brother"—role planning weekly meetings spanning arts & sciences: visiting labs, museums, libraries and studios; moral grounding and love for teenager in need of support

company.name: Big Brothers Big Sisters of America

volunteerExperiences.description: •	Organize and run essay workshops for students in intensive Western Canon program, supervise mentors and advise students
